notes.title: Moving Forward
notes.content:
Hello,

As you may know, they game is quite buggy and lags quite a bit. This is due to poor programming and optimization. Unfortunately, there is no longer a working build of the game to implement any further updates. Any changes would require a complete remake of the game (which may happen in the future), but at this time I think it's best to remove the game from steam and continue with other releases. I've learned a lot since the release and will make it a priority to communicate any issues upfront with followers of any future release.

Regards,

Mindmuscle Games.

notes.title: New Players
notes.content: Hello! If you're new to Depths of Dread, using a controller with analog support is recommended for the best experience.
